title: This is what i built, with the help of GPT ASTRA and Opus 5.5
author: Ok_Zookeepergame5024
selftext:
Hello Everyone,   
I am a software engineer, built my first game in 2017, after that , i built over a hundred of unfinished games that i never published - was trying to be perfectionnist , but today, i am happy to show what i finally released, still not good tho , but i tried my best to release it first then improve it later.

it's not a AAA game or well polished game, but to me it's something, and i will be more than happy to take critics/ideas on how to improve it.

[(572) Dogfighters: Missiles and Flares - YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/W3nIrXS87bc)

check it out here : [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lazylamagames.dogfighters&pcampaignid=web\_share](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lazylamagames.dogfighters&pcampaignid=web_share)

comments.author: Briskfall
comments.body:
Ohh- I love fighter jet sims (top down and bullet hell?)! It's a solved genre more or less, but the core gameplay is undoubtedly fun...!

Since you said that you allow for criticism, I'll go for it then...

\- I feel like the "map" so far shown in the trailer isn't very interesting. It's either you chasing one enemy or one enemy chasing you. Do you have specific boss pattern? It doesn't to entice me with a challenge, and looks like a training dummy session...

\- Where are you going with the gameplay? Mobile touch control only? Or PC? Knowing what platform it is for can help others tailor their advice better... I do see an Android version (I can't test that though), is that the sole target for release?

\- The message box at the bottom painfully scream "tech demo" or "placeholder by LLM"

\- SPD and ALT stats are displayed on the left gutter, but how relevant is that knowledge when dealing with a map? Or is it for aesthetic purpose only?

Since the genre is pretty saturated, making it stand out vs any other entries is important. Right now, the trailer's *tempo and pacing* is decent, and gave me my hopes up. But when I tried to focus on the gameplay and what the trailer offered, it seemed very barebones in many areas. There are no unique mechanism nor loadout system, nor signs of a massive hook that makes me think "I want to play this over other fighter jet simulations." So on the creative side, if you want to tempt people -- you need something to convince them that your game is more than worth it vs what already exists in the play or app store. \*You need a pull.\*

replies.author: Ok_Zookeepergame5024
replies.body: I see .. and i agree with 90% of what you said. and honestly, the idea at first was an arcade/casual game for some daily commute time pass, but as you said, the market is saturated with tese type of games/themes , and here comes the role of the critics -thank you- , i'm thinking of shifting the gameplay along with the maps.

replies.author: Ok_Zookeepergame5024

replies.author: Ok_Zookeepergame5024
replies.body: As you know, Astra doesn't need MCP, it just launch blender and execute Python script, and yes , it was blender.

replies.author: H4mst4

replies.author: Ok_Zookeepergame5024
replies.body: thank you , also fyi, you can use blender with Claude, just follow the MCP setup, it's decent but i prefer astra results.
